docket.title: Which first?
docket.why: The moot hall is too small for the town we have become. There is a second plan too: a summer fair. Which comes first?

options.label: A proper town hall
options.tradeoff: It costs 1,957 coin. The town gains a fine centre.

options.label: A summer fair
options.tradeoff: Visitors come and spend. It costs 272 coin.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: Guild seats, or an exchange hall
docket.why: The Craft Guild and the Merchant Exchange want different things. You can back one. The other will be sore.

options.label: Back the Craft Guild: guild seats
options.tradeoff: The guilds gain power. Others lose a little.

options.label: Back the Merchant Exchange: an exchange hall
options.tradeoff: It costs 1,601 coin. Trade will grow.

options.label: Back neither
options.tradeoff: Both bodies lose patience.

docket.title: Feast days
docket.why: Feast days bring us together. People need joy as well as bread.

options.label: Bring in feast days
options.tradeoff: Spirits lift. Work stops for the day.

options.label: Go further: every saint
options.tradeoff: A stronger effect. A bigger bill.

options.label: Let them decide
options.tradeoff: The Church chooses and pays from its own purse.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: A school for the ward: Marsh Town
docket.why: Children in Marsh Town walk a long way to school. The ward wants one close by.

options.label: Build it in the ward
options.tradeoff: It costs 509 coin. Learning grows in Marsh Town.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: Which first?
docket.why: The riverbank by Bridge Green is a lovely spot. Families walk out to it on rest days. Keep it green for good, with a path and a bench or two. There is a second plan too: a turnpike from old ford to marsh town. Which comes first?

options.label: Keep the riverbank by Bridge Green green
options.tradeoff: It costs 180 coin. Nobody may build there. People will walk there.

options.label: A turnpike from Old Ford to Marsh Town
options.tradeoff: It costs 8,190 coin. Trade between the towns quickens.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: Which first?
docket.why: Books are dear. A library would let everyone read. About 1 in ten people can read. There is a second plan too: free schooling. Which comes first?

options.label: A lending library
options.tradeoff: A small cost each year.

options.label: Free schooling
options.tradeoff: It costs a great deal. Fewer children earn at home.

options.label: Let them decide
options.tradeoff: The School Board chooses and pays from its own purse.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: Which first?
docket.why: Visitors spend freely at a good fair. Our name would travel. There is a second plan too: a playhouse. Which comes first?

options.label: A festival fund: a festival season
options.tradeoff: It costs coin. Some call it waste.

options.label: A playhouse
options.tradeoff: It costs 1,224 coin. Visitors and fame follow.

options.label: Let them decide
options.tradeoff: The Festival Society chooses and pays from its own purse.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: A stone quay by Crown End
docket.why: Boats tie up on the mud bank by Crown End. A stone quay would let them load in any weather.

options.label: Build the quay
options.tradeoff: It costs 1,800 coin. More boats will stop here.

options.label: Not now
options.tradeoff: They will ask again later.

options.label: Refuse
options.tradeoff: They will not like it.

docket.title: The Merchant Exchange has lost heart
docket.why: The Merchant Exchange feels ignored. Its members stopped coming. It can still be saved.

options.label: Give it a fresh start
options.tradeoff: It costs 153 coin. Its patience returns.

options.label: Let it fade
options.tradeoff: It will close within a few years.

list.place: at the ford by Bridge Green
list.title: A cart bridge at the Bridge Green ford
list.why: Carts and people splash through the ford by Bridge Green every day. A simple timber bridge would carry them over.

list.place: at the ford by Wheel End
list.title: A bridge at the Wheel End ford
list.why: Many people wade across at the ford by Wheel End. In spring it floods. A bridge would save them time.

list.place: at the ford by Brook Row
list.title: A bridge at the Brook Row ford
list.why: Many people wade across at the ford by Brook Row. In spring it floods. A bridge would save them time.

list.title: Pave the lane in Old Ford
list.why: The road in Old Ford is the busiest in town. In wet weather it turns to mud. Cobbles would keep it clean.

list.title: Build an embankment along Brook Row
list.why: Homes in Brook Row crowd the river bank. The water eats at the mud each spring. A stone embankment would hold the bank and give us a fine waterfront.

list.title: A stone quay by Crown End
list.why: Boats tie up on the mud bank by Crown End. A stone quay would let them load in any weather.

list.title: Plan the new quarter at Crown End
list.why: New homes are going up at Crown End. We could lay straight streets first. Or we can let the lanes find their own way.
